label: inputs 2/r/b/l/k/p/z or <DEL> (t>=2) in sequences starting with x/1/y/e/v/q/c
explanation: Fires during the original phase at t>=2 and at the delimiter (76% / 22% of mass); almost silent in the copy phase and never at t=0,1. Input-token gated: 2 (5.3x lift), r, b, l, k, p, z, and <DEL>; nearly never on g,h,i,t. Strongly modulated by the first original token (x,1,y,e,v,q,c give 2.5-3.7x) and by prev2_tok (c,n,a,f,v,0 raise rate), and by first occurrence of the input token (in_first: 94% of mass). Largest activations are on the last one or two original tokens and <DEL> in sequences starting x/y/e/1. Context-dependent: even in the predicted set only ~17-24% of steps are active, so the hidden-state condition is not fully captured. Without the first-token condition: recall 0.91, mass recall 0.95, precision 0.06. Phase-0-only version: F1 0.32.
